segments.name: Digital MSK Care
segments.description: Provides AI-powered digital musculoskeletal care, exercise therapy, wearables and care-team support to members of self-insured employers, health plans and government plans.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one operating segment and one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Clients, primarily self-insured employers and health plans, pay subscription fees for access to the company's MSK care platform for their contracted lives.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company currently sells its subscriptions to its customers and generates substantially all of its revenue in the U.S.
